apiKeyStepsGuide:
Quick Steps (1-2-3):
1. Open Google Cloud Console, enable Google Drive API (Library), and add your email under Test Users (OAuth Consent Screen).
2. In Credentials click [+ Create credentials] -> [OAuth client ID] -> Application type: [Desktop app] -> Create.
3. Copy the Client ID & Client Secret, paste them below, and click Save & Reconnect.
